text.description_html:
Laurey 57128, Transitional Newport 96mm Cabinet Pull in Satin Nickel

The Small Satin Nickel Newport Cabinet Pull has 96mm center to centers. The Transitional Newport 96mm Cabinet Pull in Satin Nickel comes packaged with mounting hardware. The 96mm Newport Pull Satin Nickel can be used as a kitchen cabinet pull or also in the bathroom or on furniture.

This transitional cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Newport Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 57128 96mm Pull Newport Satin Nickel:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3.78" (96mm)
  • Overall Length: 4.61"
  • Width: 0.41"
  • Projection: 1.18"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
